mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has risen steadily from -20.6 to -11.7 over three weeks, signaling a durable return to commuting routines; this lifts weekday retail footfall and raises RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its last 28-day mean if WORKPLACES continues to rise above -11.7.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT recovered from -2.9 to -1.3 and is approaching pre-pandemic baseline; once it crosses above -1.0, public mobility normalization draws shoppers to retail districts, lifting RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises above -1.0 percent change from baseline
failure_condition: If TRANSIT exceeds -1.0 and the next 2-week mean of RETAIL_REC is lower than its last 2-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of WORKPLACES improving above -15 while RESIDENTIAL stays below +6 indicates workers are leaving home for offices rather than remaining in a full lockdown; this interaction raises retail trips and RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES > -15 and RESIDENTIAL < 6 hold for two weeks while RETAIL_REC fails to rise above -12.7.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM remains above +15 points, households continue stockpiling essentials and avoid discretionary retail; this regime suppresses RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
regime_hint: partial reopening with elevated grocery demand
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM stays above 15 while RETAIL_REC 4-week mean rises above -12.6.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS staying below -20 indicates outdoor leisure remains constrained by seasonal heat or restrictions, pushing some activity indoors to air-conditioned retail spaces and raising RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
failure_condition: If PARKS remains below -20 and RETAIL_REC 2-week mean does not rise.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL above +4.5 signals a persistent work-from-home state that reduces weekday shopping trips, keeping RETAIL_REC depressed over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays above 4.5 while RETAIL_REC 4-week mean rises above -12.6.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT above -2 together with WORKPLACES above -15 creates a reinforcing mobility-normalization interaction: more commuting and transit use jointly drive retail footfall, lifting RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
failure_condition: If both TRANSIT > -2 and WORKPLACES > -15 hold while RETAIL_REC 2-week mean falls.

mechanism_narrative: A policy ceiling is reached if WORKPLACES fails to drop below -12 for two consecutive weeks; this stalled office-reopening policy keeps retail demand weak, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES remains above -12 for two weeks yet RETAIL_REC next-week mean rises above -12.7.
